_readme: Maps CSV column headers from an exported log (e.g. GAP IIDTool) to lr3diag channels. The header names below are PLACEHOLDERS: open one of your exported logs, copy its real column headers here, and set scale/offset if the units differ (values must be metric: °C, km/h, mm). Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation. Copy this file to ~/.lr3diag/gap_mapping.json to customise it.
